text: Two papers are accepted at EMNLP 2026 to be held in Budapest.
Our team attends ACM AI Summit 2026 with the paper "A Post=Transformer Vision for Efficient and Aligned AI in Software Engineering. "
ICSE 2026 was held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (April 12-18, 2026), and Prof. Mira Mezini served as Program Co-Chair.

AIware Best Benchmark Paper Award 2025: Daniel Maninger, Leon Chemnitz, Amir Molzam Sharifloo, Jannis Brugger, and Mira Mezini received the award for "Benchmarking LLMs in Web API Integration Tasks" (Benchmark and Datasets @ AIware 2025).
